body:
The design agent can propose creating or changing a design, working by element. The proposal waits for the human; nothing is saved here.

### Do

- Add a proposal command for design runs that takes operations on elements: add, remove, move, or change a property. Creating a new design is one form of it.
- Apply the operations to a copy of the design and validate the result with the design rules. A proposal that fails is refused to the agent with the element named, so a human never sees one that can't be saved.
- An operation on an element that no longer exists is refused.
- A proposal stays open until it is answered, and the run waits on it, as a strategy proposal does (D-93). A run has at most one open proposal per design.
- Record the operations in the format decision, since direct editing will reuse them (feature:c3bed08cc1bbbbb8).

### Acceptance

- Tests: each operation produces the expected design, an invalid result is refused and leaves the design unchanged, and an open proposal is returned by the run's read route.

### Left out

Drawing a proposal, and accepting or rejecting it.
title: agent: propose a design change
